summary: Backend tests for User Management (Admin) and Attendance/Payroll endpoints. 33/33 new tests pass; all 68 tests across the suite pass (no regressions).

minor.issue: Seeded users do not have an `avatar_data_url` key at all (newly created users do). Frontend should treat missing key as null.
Allows `name`/`role`/`email` updates to empty strings (e.g., name=''). No server-side validation that fields are non-empty when present in payload.
`role` field is a free-form string; no whitelist validation against allowed roles (admin/field_collector/branch_assistant/...). A typo can create an unusable user.

If a record exists for today without `check_in` (no current code path produces this, but the model allows it), the endpoint overwrites the entire record via `$set` of the new dict including a new `id`. Harmless today but fragile.

Iterates records grouped by user_id; if a user has multiple records for the same date (shouldn't happen but no unique index exists on (user_id,date)), counts can inflate. Recommend a unique compound index.

action_items: Consider validating role against a whitelist in POST/PUT /api/users.
Consider creating a unique compound index on attendance (user_id, date) to enforce one record per user per day.
Seeded users could be backfilled with avatar_data_url=None for response consistency (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is at ~688 lines — approaching the 700 line guideline; consider splitting into modules (auth, users, attendance, payments, loans) for maintainability.
require_roles uses an implicit 'admin always allowed' override (`user['role'] != 'admin'`). This is correct, but a comment explaining the bypass would improve readability.
Attendance hours are computed from timezone-aware UTC times; correct. Status logic in payroll uses (present|late) for gross pay — matches the spec.
PUT /api/users/{id}: when `email` provided but identical (case-insensitive) to existing, no-ops correctly. Good.
DELETE /api/users/{id}: returns 404 if user not found — good. Self-delete returns 400 before lookup — good.

seed_data_creation: Test users created via POST /api/users with email prefix `testu_` (lowercased server-side from `TESTU_`). Each test cleans up created users in a module-scoped teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three regression suites live in /app/backend/tests/: test_efcis_backend.py (21), test_payments_backend.py (14), test_users_attendance_backend.py (33). All 68 pass. The new suite covers /api/users CRUD (admin), /api/attendance check-in/out/me/today, admin list+update, and payroll computation incl. role enforcement (403) and auth (401).
